name: Concealed cistern frame
summary: A steel frame inside the wall holds a flat cistern and two studs. The WC hangs on the studs, and only the bowl and a flush plate show in the room.
how: Fix a steel frame to the floor and the wall, with the studs at 180 or 230 mm centres.
Hide a flat cistern of 6 to 9 litres and its pipes in the frame.
Hang the bowl on the studs and seal it to the wall with a rubber boot.
Cover the frame with a wall and fit a flush plate with 2 buttons.

origin.note: Sanitary firms make flat in-wall cisterns, so that the wall can hide the water tank of a WC.

adoptions.via: Designers use the frame to hang the WC on the wall, so that the bowl floats and the floor stays clear.
